name: Two-stage Gaussian-Surfel (GES) Optimization
definition: A bi-scale training pipeline that first optimizes opaque surfels to establish coarse geometry, then jointly optimizes 2D/3D Gaussians with surfels to enrich appearance and smooth geometry.
summary: Two-stage Gaussian-Surfel optimization separates opaque surface initialization from joint appearance refinement, preventing color leakage by establishing a coarse surfel backbone before adding 3D Gaussians for fine details.
